messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant. Always respond in 2-5 sentences.

I don't have time for a deep dive into every single minor administrative thread.

You cut off there. Just get straight to the point—give me the summary of the material compliance docs so I can prep for the board. I need the high-level overview of everything that actually matters for the merger.

I'm under a massive time crunch here. Just scan the discovery files for anything that impacts their regulatory standing or compliance history. I need the summary of the relevant files now so I can confirm there are no red flags before I walk into that merger meeting. If it's a standard administrative filing or a minor internal memo, just skip it—I only need the stuff that could actually sink this deal.
